params.body:
## The workbench capability names the writes to Portal

Third piece of the same handshake, after abovebeyond-ai/control#38 (the Portal adapter) and abovebeyond-ai/elixir#182 (the grant). The gateway requires a submission's kind and resource to be in both the grant and the capability, so Portal's capability for `workbench` now names the seven `portal.*` kinds and the project as `portal:<slug>`, next to the repository.

- A project without a repository used to get a 409 ("nothing to name"); the workbench writes to Portal about such a project too, so it now gets a capability naming the project alone. The playbooks keep their repository requirement.
- Tests: kinds and resources of the workbench capability; the repository-less project; the per-hand verbs table.

Full suite: 505 of 506 pass; `BuildStampTest` fails identically on `main` in a fresh checkout (it wants a build stamp the deploy writes) and is unrelated.
params.title: Workbench capability: the writes to Portal, and a project without a repository
